script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.
It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: It assigns a purpose to the serpent's wording that the text does not give.
It says the woman reports exactly what she was told, but the text does not establish that God told her not to touch the fruit.
It says the woman repeated what God said, including her claim about touching the fruit. The text does not establish that God gave that instruction.
It claims to know what the serpent can think of, which the text does not say.
It says nobody planned for the coverings, although the text does not say what either person had planned.
It says the man and woman had been walking around in the garden before, which the passage does not say.
It says the man was not too busy to come out. The text gives his reason for hiding but does not say whether he was busy or came out.
It minimizes the strike to the heel and declares which injury is worse. The verse does not describe the severity of the strike.
The head pun makes light of the violent image of the serpent's head being crushed.
The passage says the way to the tree of life is guarded, not that the way back into the garden is guarded.
